problemStatement.formal: S_n is solvable ↔ n ≤ 4; A_n is solvable ↔ n ≤ 4; A₅ is simple; not solvable Galois group implies not solvable by radicals
problemStatement.plain: Extend the Abel-Ruffini formalization with complete group-theoretic structure: solvability classification of symmetric and alternating groups, Klein four-group construction, cardinality computations, and solvability preservation theorems.
whyMatters: Complete the sharp threshold characterization for polynomial solvability by radicals
Demonstrates rich Galois theory infrastructure in Lean 4 + Mathlib
Connects abstract group theory to concrete polynomial solvability

proven: S₀, S₁, S₂, S₃, S₄ are solvable (with explicit proofs)
A₀, A₁, A₂, A₃, A₄ are solvable
Not solvable Galois group ⟹ not solvable by radicals (contrapositive)
Klein four-group V₄ construction and normality in A₄
Cardinalities: |S_n| = n! for n=0..8, |A_n| = n!/2 for n=0..8
Non-commutativity witnesses for S₃, S₄, S₅, A₄, A₅
